tasks.label: source-ws
tasks.detail: Source the current ROS2 workspace and write environment variables to .env
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.zsh && if [ -f ${workspaceFolder}/install/local_setup.zsh ]; then source ${workspaceFolder}/install/local_setup.zsh; fi && printenv > ${workspaceFolder}/.env

tasks.label: colcon-build-all-debug
tasks.detail: Build all packages in debug mode
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.zsh && colcon build --symlink-install --cmake-args -G Ninja -D CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && compile_commands="$(find build -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name compile_commands.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" && if [ -n "$compile_commands" ]; then ln -sf "${compile_commands#build/}" build/compile_commands.json; fi

tasks.label: colcon-build-debug
tasks.detail: Build one package in debug mode
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.zsh && colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select ${input:pkg-name} --cmake-args -G Ninja -D CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && compile_commands="$(find build/${input:pkg-name} -maxdepth 1 -name compile_commands.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" && if [ -n "$compile_commands" ]; then ln -sf "${compile_commands#build/}" build/compile_commands.json; fi

tasks.label: colcon-build-release
tasks.detail: Build one package in release mode
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.zsh && colcon build --build-base build-release --install-base install-release --symlink-install --packages-select ${input:pkg-name} --cmake-args -G Ninja -D CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

tasks.label: colcon-clean-debug
tasks.detail: Clean one package from debug build directories

tasks.label: colcon-clean-release
tasks.detail: Clean one package from release build directories
